limits: Evidence applies to this concrete run and finite observation checkpoint, not unrestricted long-duration reliability.

conclusion: Four genuine turn-to-cruise handoffs completed in this captured finite window. Current fifth turn is unfinished and long-term navigation is not certified.

deployment_limit: ZeroXYZ is a velocity reference, not a position-hold guarantee against water drift. This finite checkpoint does not claim all future turn settling or navigation reliability.
